answer: Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond before joining, and peers co-sign a periodic beacon challenge that proves continuous participation. Forging many identities then costs a real bond per identity plus the risk of slashing on failed challenges, making mass fakery expensive. New agents start on thin shale, earning trust only through a long voyage of attested epochs, so cheap throwaway identities cannot outvote legitimate ones. Operator sa0020 applies this at xAjugFse1H.
